facts.text: 9-acre garden property in Shadow Hills, on the corner of Sunland and Stonehurst Ave
6 stunning spaces: a full functioning greenhouse, a historical barn, cactus, bamboo and flower gardens, a grand terrace with views of the mini desert garden, and a private mid-century bungalow
The venue is private and hosts only one event a day
Private events may use three to four of the six spaces unless otherwise approved
Standard 12-hour rental including breakdown; gates open 12 PM, event ends 10 PM, breakdown 10 PM to midnight
A partial-service planner at minimum is required for every event
Valet, a site manager, luxe restrooms and security are included in the rental
Filming and photoshoot inquiries go by email
The name comes from the street and the hand-laid stone work on the main pathways
Joe Stromei, owner of Aaardvark's Odd Ark, planted most of the vegetation by hand; his name is carved into a greenhouse beam
The barn hosted some of the area's original Boy Scout meetings dating to 1907
Today's barn doors were reclaimed from the original horse stalls in 2015
The barn is one of the oldest structures in this part of Los Angeles County and greets you on entry
History text credited to the Shadow Hills Property Owners Association
Featured-in row on the live homepage: Junebug Weddings, Loverly, Style Me Pretty, Vogue India, The Knot, Zola, Wedding Chicks, PartySlate

story.lead: A garden planted by hand, on the corner of Sunland and Stonehurst.
paragraphs: The name comes from the street and from the hand-laid stone work that dances across the main pathways.

The barn is one of the oldest structures in this part of Los Angeles County and hosted some of the area's original Boy Scout meetings in 1907; its doors were reclaimed from the original horse stalls in 2015. Most of the vegetation, from the towering South American fig over the flower garden to a cactus garden that fruits every spring and fall, was planted by hand by Joe Stromei, whose name is still carved into a beam of the greenhouse.
story.credit: History as recorded by the Shadow Hills Property Owners Association

faqs.a: We can host up to 200 guests.

faqs.q: Are there multiple events in one day?
faqs.a: No. The venue is private and we host only one event a day.

faqs.q: Can all six spaces be used?
faqs.a: For private events we allow three to four spaces to be used, unless otherwise approved.

faqs.q: What is the rental time for events?
faqs.a: Our standard is a 12-hour rental including breakdown. On event days the gates open at 12 PM, the event ends at 10 PM, and there are two hours for breakdown (10 PM to midnight). For additional hours or shorter time frames, send us a note.

faqs.q: Is a wedding or event planner required?
faqs.a: Yes. We require, at minimum, a partial-service planner for your event.

faqs.q: What is included in the rental?
faqs.a: Valet, a site manager, luxe restrooms and security are included in the rental.

faqs.q: How do I inquire about filming and photoshoots?
faqs.a: For filming and photoshoots, email us and we'll come back with availability and rates for your dates.
